annotations.title: Find a page by its permanent id or old link

description: Resolves a permanent Craft Quantities id (such as cq-c0412), a current or earlier slug, or a craftquantities.com address to the page as it is today: its kind, current slug, slug history, page link and permanent /id/ link. Ids are assigned once and kept when a page is renamed or moved; a removed page names its replacement.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

ref.description: A permanent id (cq-c0412), a current or earlier slug, or a craftquantities.com address.

name: resolve_id

matches.description: The pages the reference names: one for an id, more where pages of different kinds share a slug.

history.description: Every slug the page has had, the current one last.

id.description: The permanent id: assigned once, kept whatever the page's slug or category becomes.

permanentUrl.description: The site's /id/ address for the page, which redirects to wherever the page is.

slug.description: The slug the page answers on today.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
